subject: Taxes
title: Wrapped Tokens and Tax Events
description: A quick, practical guide to Wrapped Tokens and Tax Events.

hook.text: Wrapping Bitcoin into WBTC for use on Ethereum might be a taxable event.

buildup.text: WBTC is supposed to be Bitcoin, just on a different blockchain.

discovery.text: Some tax practitioners argue wrapping is like exchanging dollars for a dollar-denominated check—same value, same asset.

twist.text: The IRS hasn't ruled on wrapped tokens. DeFi users face a legal void where reasonable people reach opposite conclusions.

climax.text: Wrapped tokens show how crypto's layered ecosystem creates tax questions unknown five years ago that remain unsolved.

punchline.text: Same Bitcoin, different wrapper. One conversion, zero official guidance.

quiz.question: Why might wrapping Bitcoin into WBTC be a tax issue?
options: The IRS could view it as converting one asset to another, triggering a taxable event
